messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: installing lavaan
parts:
On 7/30/20 3:49 PM, Terrence Jorgensen wrote:
>  there is no package called ‘mnormt’

I noticed that 'mnormt' has recently been updated (current version:
2.0.1), and more importantly, it now requires R (≥ 4.0.0).

So make sure you are using a recent (>4.0.0) version of R before you try
installing mnormt. If you must use an older version of R, you will have
to install an older version of mnormt (eg 1.5-7).

Yves.
